name: scroll-storyboard
description: 滚动驱动的分镜叙事编排器
interaction: As the user scrolls, the page reveals sequential storyboard panels with cinematic transitions—zooms, fades, and parallax shifts—each triggered by precise scroll positions. Users can rearrange scenes via drag-and-drop in an edit mode, and the scroll timeline auto-recalculates keyframes in real time, turning passive reading into an immersive, frame-by-frame narrative journey.
